title: Deoxythymidylate Kinase (DTYMK)-Driven Pyrimidine Hypermetabolism Is Associated with a Folate-Dependent Macrophage Programme in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer.
snippet: Immune checkpoint blockade benefits only a minority of patients with triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), and the tumour-intrinsic programmes that establish its immunosuppressive microenvironment remain poorly defined. title: Uncovering Immune Cell-Specific lncRNAs as Anti-PD-1 Response-Associated Markers in Breast Cancer.
snippet: Long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) are critical regulators of the tumor microenvironment (TME); however, their cell-specific roles in predicting immunotherapy response in breast cancer (BC) remain poorly understood.
